```yaml
name: Smoke Tests - Mastodon Interoperability

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Build Fedify application
        run: npm run build
        
      - name: Start Mastodon stack and Fedify harness
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose up -d
          
      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          timeout 120 bash -c 'until docker compose exec -T web rails console -e production -c "puts \"Rails is ready\""; do sleep 5; done'
          
      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          cd test/smoke
          deno run --allow-net --allow-read orchestrator.ts
          
      - name: Stop services
        if: always()
        run: |
          cd test/smoke/mastodon
          docker compose down -v
          
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: smoke-test-results
          path: test/smoke/mastodon/logs/
```
